001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.combat;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
006
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.BeamAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.BeamEffectPlugin;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEngineAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEntityAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.DamageAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.WeaponAPI;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.listeners.AdvanceableListener;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.TimeoutTracker;
016
017public class TacticalLaserEffect implements BeamEffectPlugin {
018
019        public static float EFFECT_DUR = 1f;
020        
021        public static float [] DAMAGE_PERCENT_BONUS = new float[] {3f, 6f, 8f, 10f};
022        
023        protected boolean wasZero = true;
024        
025        public void advance(float amount, CombatEngineAPI engine, BeamAPI beam) {
026                CombatEntityAPI target = beam.getDamageTarget();
027                if (target instanceof ShipAPI && beam.getBrightness() >= 1f && beam.getWeapon() != null) {
028                        float dur = beam.getDamage().getDpsDuration();
029                        // needed because when the ship is in fast-time, dpsDuration will not be reset every frame as it should be
030                        if (!wasZero) dur = 0;
031                        wasZero = beam.getDamage().getDpsDuration() <= 0;
032                        
033                        // beam tick, apply damage modifier effect if needed
034                        if (dur > 0) {
035                                boolean hitShield = target.getShield() != null && target.getShield().isWithinArc(beam.getTo());
036                                if (!hitShield) {
037                                        ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) target;
038                                        if (!ship.hasListenerOfClass(TacticalLaserDamageTakenMod.class)) {
039                                                ship.addListener(new TacticalLaserDamageTakenMod(ship));
040                                        }
041                                        List<TacticalLaserDamageTakenMod> listeners = ship.getListeners(TacticalLaserDamageTakenMod.class);
042                                        if (listeners.isEmpty()) return; // ???
043                                        
044                                        TacticalLaserDamageTakenMod listener = listeners.get(0);
045                                        listener.notifyHit(beam.getWeapon());
046                                }
047                        }
048                }
049        }
050        
051
052        public static String DAMAGE_MOD_ID = "taclaser_dam_mod";
053
054        public static class TacticalLaserDamageTakenMod implements AdvanceableListener {
055                                                        //implements DamageTakenModifier, AdvanceableListener {
056                protected ShipAPI ship;
057                protected TimeoutTracker<WeaponAPI> recentHits = new TimeoutTracker<WeaponAPI>();
058                public TacticalLaserDamageTakenMod(ShipAPI ship) {
059                        this.ship = ship;
060                        //ship.addListener(new GravitonBeamDamageTakenModRemover(ship));
061                }
062                
063                public void notifyHit(WeaponAPI w) {
064                        recentHits.add(w, EFFECT_DUR, EFFECT_DUR);
065                        
066                }
067                
068                public void advance(float amount) {
069                        recentHits.advance(amount);
070                        
071                        int beams = recentHits.getItems().size();
072                        beams--;
073                        if (beams >= DAMAGE_PERCENT_BONUS.length) {
074                                beams = DAMAGE_PERCENT_BONUS.length - 1;
075                        }
076                        float bonus = 0;
077                        
078                        if (beams >= 0) {
079                                bonus = DAMAGE_PERCENT_BONUS[beams];
080                        }
081                        
082                        if (bonus > 0) {
083                                ship.getMutableStats().getArmorDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(DAMAGE_MOD_ID, 1f + bonus * 0.01f);
084                                ship.getMutableStats().getHullDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(DAMAGE_MOD_ID, 1f + bonus * 0.01f);
085                        } else {
086                                ship.removeListener(this);
087                                ship.getMutableStats().getArmorDamageTakenMult().unmodify(DAMAGE_MOD_ID);
088                                ship.getMutableStats().getHullDamageTakenMult().unmodify(DAMAGE_MOD_ID);
089                        }
090                }
091
092                public String modifyDamageTaken(Object param,
093                                                                                CombatEntityAPI target, DamageAPI damage,
094                                                                                Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit) {
095                        return null;
096                }
097
098        }
099
100}
